jobDescription:
We are looking for a friendly Digital Inclusion Assistant to help older people and residents across Manchester get online with confidence. This is an entry level role and full training is provided.

Key responsibilities:

  • Support residents one to one at weekly digital help sessions in local libraries
  • Plan and promote community events and workshops on social media
  • Keep accurate records of attendance and feedback using Microsoft Office
  • Produce monthly reports on digital skills outcomes

About you:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to speak Mandarin or Cantonese is desirable

Please complete the application form and supporting statement. CVs will not be accepted. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. An enhanced DBS check is required.
